# Overmarketing Word Optimization

|  |
| --- |
| The following words are not appropriate as separate unlawful conclusions, but it is suggested that preference be given to recast as verifiable product functions, parameters or conditions for use: |
| The words "subversive, revolutionary, epochal, world class, ceiling, phenomenon level, ace, explosive, theorem, black technology, unstoppable, all-powerful, perfect." |
| Overexposure words: seconds open, seconds understood, one key done, zero threshold, zero learning costs, no sense, seamlessness, free will, once and for all. |
| Influencing words: must buy, must enter, must be prepared, must buy or lose, must miss regret, can no longer buy, and wise people are using them. |
| Self-proclaimed authority: expert level, master level, industry-recognized, industry-consensual, network-wide, user-recognized, national brand. |
| Rewrite examples: |

| High-risk text | Suggested redraft |
| --- | --- |
| Industry-first corporate platform | Integrated platform for enterprise office scenes |
| 100% No data leaks | Support hierarchy, operation audit and transmission encryption, depending on deployment configuration |
| Zero learning. One key. | Provide visual configuration and guidance to reduce configuration steps for common processes |
| 80% efficiency improvement | 80% reduction in the average after-line processing time compared to the first three months of a client ' s assignment process (source: project data confirmed by the relevant party as of YYY-MM-DD) |
| The only platform that supports a function | Support a function, apply to a version and specified configuration |
| Low code SaaS platform | A cloud business service platform that supports visualization configuration |
